items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: But after I had come back from Honolulu, I worked with Gerry Wiggins and Bill Douglass. It was Gerry Wiggins' trio.

ctx.x: So did you and Gerry Wiggins work together other than... I mean, he was in Les Hite's band and you had the intermission trio. But did you two work together any time apart from that?

Oh, yes, indeed. I don't know whether I told this before or not. But after I had come back from Honolulu, I worked with Gerry Wiggins and Bill Douglass. It was Gerry Wiggins' trio. We worked in the Turban Room on Central Avenue, which was sandwiched in between the Alabam and the Dunbar. We worked there I guess off and on for a couple of years.
